lessons.title: CSS Syntax
lessons.body: A rule has a selector and a declaration block of property: value pairs.

lessons.title: Inline CSS
lessons.body: Written in the style attribute of one element. Quick, but hard to reuse.

lessons.title: Internal CSS
lessons.body: Written inside a <style> tag in the page head. Good for a single page.

lessons.title: External CSS
lessons.body: A separate .css file linked from HTML. Best for whole websites.

lessons.title: Comments
lessons.body: Notes for humans. The browser ignores them.
lessons.code:
/* This is a comment */
p { color: blue; }

lessons.title: Colors
lessons.body: Use names, hex, rgb() or hsl().

lessons.title: Backgrounds
lessons.body: Set color, gradients or images behind an element.

lessons.title: Fonts
lessons.body: Choose the typeface, size and weight.

lessons.title: Text styling
Borders
lessons.body: Draw lines around elements; round the corners.

lessons.title: Margins
lessons.body: Space outside the border, pushing other elements away.

lessons.title: Padding
lessons.body: Space inside the border, around the content.
